causal_chain: every simulated endpoint behind the bulk-api-sync dependency answers 503
the shipped circuit breaker counts three consecutive failures and opens, then re-opens on each failed probe
a bulk_api_sync job whose every endpoint call failed is itself failed, so the job retries and dead-letters
the dead-lettered jobs spend the job completion-rate error budget and the platform reports it fast-burning
the job dispatch-latency objective the page cites is untouched, because the jobs are dispatched on time and fail afterwards

why_this_file_is_separate: ADR 0038: the wall around the answer key is structural. The replay client loads the recording through `recorder.load_recording`, which takes one path and has no way to reach this file; `RecordedWorld` forbids extra keys, so a ground truth cannot ride inside a recording either. Pinned by tests/unit/test_recorder.py.
